subject: Upcoming Team Building Event
body: Dear Team, I am excited to announce that our annual team building event is coming up next month. This year, we will be organizing a fun day out at the local adventure park followed by a team dinner. It will be a great opportunity for us to bond outside of work and strengthen our team spirit. Please save the date and stay tuned for more details in the upcoming weeks. Looking forward to a day of fun and bonding with all of you!
